name: Sunsama
tagline: Sunsama is a daily planning tool that pulls tasks from Asana, Todoist, GitHub, Linear, and other tools into a single daily plan. Its AI suggests how to organise your day based on available time and priorities. It emphasises sustainable work rhythms with time-boxing and end-of-day shutdown rituals.
